description:
Determine the partial correlation between 'Exam' and 'Anxiety' in the Exam Anxiety dataset, controlling for 'Revise'. 

1. Open JASP and load the dataset '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv'.
2. Open the Correlation module (Regression > Correlation).
3. Set 'Exam' and 'Anxiety' as the variables.
4. Set 'Revise' as the 'Conditioned on' (control) variable.
5. Enable 'Report significance', 'Confidence intervals' (95%), and 'Scatter plots'.
6. Save the analysis as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/PartialCorrelation_Exam.jasp'.
